rules.protein_name: Type IIa receptor protein tyrosine phosphatase-like protein

rule_revision_context: Configured-expected-family calibration using 78 positive controls in calibration_set.xlsx: PTPRF LAR rule dispatch and R-PTPc-F specific hit; canonical ERM F1 discriminator against NF2/Merlin; observed kindlin F0/fermitin and PTPN1 PTPc-N1 hit names. Unchanged mandatory architecture, domain counts, grade gates, negative exclusions, and numerical calibration. This is calibration-panel rule review, not a held-out validation. Expansion adds evidence-gated identity rules only where all family positives match Pfam+specific CDD and no other labelled control does in the frozen calibration panel; retain conservative thresholds and validate runtime.
